About Lena

Science without the noise.

I spent years frustrated by the gap between cutting-edge longevity research and what people actually do day to day. The science on biological ageing is extraordinary — but it's buried in papers most people will never read.

Longeviq is my answer to that. A clear baseline. A personalised protocol. Real results you can feel within a month.

I focus on the nine biomarkers with the strongest evidence base — the ones you can actually move without expensive interventions or extreme lifestyle changes.

Focuses on evidence-based longevity research from Nature, Cell, and PubMed
Specialises in accessible, sustainable health optimisation for busy professionals
Created the Longeviq 9-KPI baseline framework, validated against published biomarker studies

The research

Biological age is reversible.

Every KPI in the Longeviq baseline is drawn from peer-reviewed longevity research. These aren't wellness trends — they're the markers that predict mortality, disease risk, and cognitive decline across decades of population studies.

The good news: all nine are modifiable. The right interventions — targeted to your specific profile — can move your biological age meaningfully within 30 days.

Your 9 biomarkers

What the scan measures.

SL
Sleep Quality
Foundation of every longevity marker. Poor sleep accelerates all-cause ageing.
EN
Energy Level
Reflects mitochondrial health and metabolic efficiency.
CG
Cognitive Sharpness
Early predictor of neurological ageing and dementia risk.
GS
Grip Strength
One of the single best predictors of all-cause mortality.
HR
Resting Heart Rate
Lower RHR = stronger cardiovascular reserve = longer healthspan.
WC
Waist Circumference
The most accessible proxy for visceral fat and metabolic risk.
MR
Mood & Resilience
Chronic stress shortens telomeres and accelerates cellular ageing.
ST
Physical Strength
Muscle mass is the longevity organ. The earlier you build it, the longer you keep it.
RC
Recovery Speed
Systemic resilience — how quickly your body returns to baseline after stress.
